name: astilba
description: Astilba's monorepo: Env, Cache, UI, docs and the apex site.

scripts.verify: pnpm verify:ui && pnpm verify:env && pnpm verify:web && pnpm verify:cache
scripts.verify:env: pnpm --dir packages/env lint && pnpm --dir packages/env knip && pnpm --dir packages/env verify
scripts.verify:env:archive: pnpm --dir packages/env pack:artifact && pnpm --dir packages/env verify:artifact
scripts.verify:ui: pnpm verify:ui:base && pnpm --dir apps/ui-showcase test:browser && pnpm --dir apps/ui-showcase deploy:dry-run
scripts.verify:ui:base: pnpm lint:root && pnpm knip && pnpm build:ui && pnpm --filter @astilba/tokens --filter @astilba/ui --filter @astilba/showcase --filter @astilba/integration-astro -r typecheck && pnpm --filter @astilba/tokens --filter @astilba/ui --filter @astilba/showcase --filter @astilba/integration-astro -r test && pnpm pack:check
